description: Find games that are gaining players or reviews right now (Roblox, Steam, Fortnite; iOS and itch.io have no momentum reading yet). Filter by platform, genre, title keyword, players online, age, positive share, niche stage; exclude ids already seen; page with nextCursor. Sort values are the field they sort by: momentum (default), growth24hPct, playersNow, acceleration, newest (smallest ageDays). By default small Steam games are hidden (50+ reviews in 7 days and 50+ players online when measured): includeSmall=true shows them. Start here for "what is rising" questions, then call get_game on an id. Every game carries asOf (export time, UTC), source and grade (grade = completeness of the game record (A = 8+ of 10 data points known, B = 6-7, C = 4-5, D = fewer); estimate grade: B = tighter range, C = wide range, D = very rough order of magnitude.) Revenue figures are estimates with a range and a grade, never measured sales and never a guarantee. Definitions: resource wieldr://methodology.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call, to get the next page. Omit for the first page.

excludeIds.description: Wieldr ids to leave out (e.g. games already suggested).

includeSmall.description: true = also return small Steam games under the default floor.

keyword.description: Word in the title or genre, e.g. "brainrot".

limit.description: How many results per page (default 10, max 25).

maxAgeDays.description: Only games released at most this many days ago.

maxPlayers.description: Maximum players online now (find small games before they are crowded).

minPositivePct.description: Minimum share of positive reviews or votes (0-100); games with an unknown share are left out.

nicheStage.description: Only games in a ranked Roblox or Fortnite niche at this stage (see list_niches).

onlyAnomalies.description: Only games flagged as a velocity anomaly.

platform.description: steam, roblox, ios, itch (itch.io) or fortnite. Omit for all platforms.

sort.description: Field to sort by, descending (newest = youngest first). Default momentum.

name: find_emerging_games

dataset.description: full radar (Pro or Studio key) or free preview (no key).

niches.description: Ranked Roblox or Fortnite niches of the game; null = not computed (other platforms).

wieldrUrl.description: Public Wieldr page for this game or niche, to cite or link. Present only when the page exists (games of the free preview, ranked niches).
